passages.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
He gave it to the choirmaster.
The choirmaster led music in worship.
David was the king of Israel.
David trusted God.
David often prayed and sang to God.

passages.text: Hear, O God, my voice of complaint; preserve my life from dread of the enemy.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm for the choirmaster.
David speaks to God.
David asks God to hear his voice.
David brings his complaint to God.
David asks God to protect his life.
David fears his enemy.
David asks God to keep him safe from fear of the enemy.
passages.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃ שְׁמַע־ אֱלֹהִ֣ים קוֹלִ֣י בְשִׂיחִ֑י מִפַּ֥חַד א֝וֹיֵ֗ב תִּצֹּ֥ר חַיָּֽי׃

passages.text: Hide me from the scheming of the wicked, from the mob of workers of iniquity, who sharpen their tongues like swords and aim their bitter words like arrows, ambushing the innocent in seclusion, shooting suddenly, without fear.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David speaks to God.
David asks God to hide him.
David wants protection from the wicked.
The wicked make secret plans.
The wicked gather together and do evil.
These people sharpen their tongues like swords.
They use their words to hurt others.
Their words are like arrows.
They aim their bitter words at people.
They attack innocent people in secret places.
They shoot at the innocent suddenly.
They do not feel fear when they attack.
passages.original: תַּ֭סְתִּירֵנִי מִסּ֣וֹד מְרֵעִ֑ים מֵ֝רִגְשַׁ֗ת פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃ אֲשֶׁ֤ר שָׁנְנ֣וּ כַחֶ֣רֶב לְשׁוֹנָ֑ם דָּרְכ֥וּ חִ֝צָּ֗ם דָּבָ֥ר מָֽר׃ לִיר֣וֹת בַּמִּסְתָּרִ֣ים תָּ֑ם פִּתְאֹ֥ם יֹ֝רֻ֗הוּ וְלֹ֣א יִירָֽאוּ׃

passages.text: They hold fast to their evil purpose; they speak of hiding their snares. “Who will see them?” they say.
passages.sermon:
Wicked people make evil plans.
They do not let go of their evil purpose.
They talk about hiding traps for others.
They say, “Who will see us?”
passages.original: יְחַזְּקוּ־ לָ֨מוֹ׀ דָּ֘בָ֤ר רָ֗ע יְֽ֭סַפְּרוּ לִטְמ֣וֹן מוֹקְשִׁ֑ים אָ֝מְר֗וּ מִ֣י יִרְאֶה־ לָּֽמוֹ׃

passages.text: They devise injustice and say, “We have perfected a secret plan.” For the inner man and the heart are mysterious.
passages.sermon:
Wicked people make evil plans.
They say, “We have made a perfect secret plan.”
A person’s inner thoughts are hidden.
A person’s heart is deep and hard to understand.
passages.original: יַֽחְפְּֽשׂוּ־ עוֹלֹ֗ת תַּ֭מְנוּ חֵ֣פֶשׂ מְחֻפָּ֑שׂ וְקֶ֥רֶב אִ֝֗ישׁ וְלֵ֣ב עָמֹֽק׃

passages.text: But God will shoot them with arrows; suddenly they will be wounded.
passages.sermon:
God acts with power.
God shoots arrows at the wicked.
God acts suddenly.
The wicked become wounded at once.
passages.original: וַיֹּרֵ֗ם אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים חֵ֥ץ פִּתְא֑וֹם הָ֝י֗וּ מַכּוֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: They will be made to stumble, their own tongues turned against them. All who see will shake their heads.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm as a song for the choirmaster.
David describes people who plan evil in secret.
God acts against these people.
God causes them to stumble.
Their own tongues turn against them.
People see what happens to them.
Everyone who sees them shakes their head.
passages.original: וַיַּכְשִׁיל֣וּהוּ עָלֵ֣ימוֹ לְשׁוֹנָ֑ם יִ֝תְנֹדֲד֗וּ כָּל־ רֹ֥אֵה בָֽם׃

passages.text: Then all mankind will fear and proclaim the work of God; so they will ponder what He has done.
passages.sermon:
All people will see what God has done.
All people will feel fear because of God’s actions.
All people will speak about God’s work.
All people will think carefully about what God has done.
passages.original: וַיִּֽירְא֗וּ כָּל־ אָ֫דָ֥ם וַ֭יַּגִּידוּ פֹּ֥עַל אֱלֹהִ֗ים וּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֥הוּ הִשְׂכִּֽילוּ׃

passages.text: Let the righteous rejoice in the LORD and take refuge in Him; let all the upright in heart exult.
passages.sermon:
The righteous person trusts in the LORD.
The righteous person finds safety in the LORD.
The righteous person rejoices in the LORD.
All people who are upright in heart praise the LORD.
All people who are upright in heart celebrate.
passages.original: יִשְׂמַ֬ח צַדִּ֣יק בַּ֭יהוָה וְחָ֣סָה ב֑וֹ וְ֝יִתְהַֽלְל֗וּ כָּל־ יִשְׁרֵי־ לֵֽב׃
